none: PAS NLM-6AC34F: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly a Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-340, possibly irregular copy, Reece period 17. Possibly darkened by treatment with oil by the finder. Obverse description: Bust possibly laureate right. Reverse description: two soldiers with an indeterminate number of standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter:…
